name: capture-to-print
description: Generate editable OpenSCAD from confirmed measurements and build, measure, preview, and package traceable draft parts.

interface.longDescription: Measurement-driven OpenSCAD workflow: editable source, hash-bound contract, mesh measurements, four actual-mesh previews and a traceable draft bundle. Ships as a DeepSeek Harness bundle and a Codex plugin over the same local runner. Requires Python 3.11, OpenSCAD and fontconfig; no hosted execution or paid API.
defaultPrompt: Build and check the unchanged plant-label fixture.
Help turn my photo and measurements into editable OpenSCAD.
